title: nephrodium patens var. stipulare
intro: Nephrodium patens var. stipulare, commonly known as Stipule Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium patens var. stipulare are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. However, there is limited scientific research on this plant, and more studies are needed to confirm its efficacy and potential side effects.
